exposure: injection of DXMS and lidocaine mixture around the epidural puncture point
injection of 0.9% sodium chloride and lidocaine mixture around the epidural puncture point
outcome: Incidence of lower back pain after epidural labor analgesia
Degree of lower back pain (measured by pain visual analogue scale)
cohort: 368 pregnant primipara with full-term single birth who underwent epidural labor analgesia
finding: Local pretreatment with dexamethasone before epidural labor analgesia significantly reduced the incidence and degree of lower back pain compared to pretreatment with sodium chloride.
mod_finding: Local pretreatment with dexamethasone was associated with a lower incidence of postoperative lower back pain in both spontaneous vaginal delivery and cesarean section groups.
